chain_words.nuance: to put forward an idea tentatively, without full proof
to state a position firmly, in the face of possible objections
to present reasons in support of a claim
to insist on a position despite challenges
to assert something forcefully, refusing to accept any alternative

explanation: These words all describe putting forward a claim, moving from a tentative suggestion to a forceful insistence that allows no alternative.

usage_notes.difference: 'Contend' suggests defending a claim against opposition; 'maintain' suggests holding a position steadily over time, even when challenged.
